question: What ritual preparations are made at the tip of the liṅga after the devotional acts?
premises: An altar is to be made at the tip of the liṅga.
The Śiva pot and the vardhanī vessel are involved.
These preparations follow the prior devotional acts.
inference: After the devotional acts, one should make an altar at the liṅga's tip and prepare the Śiva pot and vardhanī.
uncertainties: Internal structure of śivakuṃbhasyavardhanīm is compact; taken as Śiva pot and vardhanī vessel.
plain_english: Having made an altar at the tip of the liṅga, one should prepare the Śiva pot and the vardhanī.
